description: Lists the safety recalls NHTSA has issued for a vehicle's year, make and model, or for a VIN (decoded first). Shows campaign number, component, summary and remedy. It cannot say whether a recall is still open on one specific vehicle; that is checked by VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with the dealer.

vin.description: A 17-character VIN (used instead of year, make and model)

name: recall_lookup
title: NHTSA recall lookup
